title: Real property, property published, deposit for publication not stated

expect.why: The text requires publication 'إذا تعلقت بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر' and presentation at the first hearing 'ما لم يثبت إيداعها للإشهار'. Both conditions hold, so the step is required; whether the petition was deposited for publication is a fact no slot holds, so the case is left open and the rule must ask the lawyer. (The texts give no time limit counted from a date in the slots: the limit is the first hearing, whose date is not a slot.)

title: Real property, property published, status of the property unknown

expect.why: The duty exists only for a property or real right 'مشهر طبقا للقانون'. Whether the property is published is unknown, so it is not 'no': the rule cannot decide whether the step is required and must ask.

title: Property published, nature of the dispute unknown

expect.why: The duty applies 'إذا تعلقت بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري'. Whether the dispute concerns real property or a real right is unknown, so the rule must ask rather than assume either way.

title: Property not published at the land registry

expect.why: The text limits the duty to real property or a real right 'مشهر طبقا للقانون'. The property is not published, so the duty does not arise: no publication is required, the sanction of non-admissibility does not apply. The outcome stepExempt is the nearest available: the case holds no fact on whether the petition was deposited.

title: Dispute not about real property (movable), property slot says published

expect.why: The duty needs a petition that concerns real property or a real right ('إذا تعلقت بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري'). The dispute does not, so the step is not required whatever the other slot says. stepExempt is the nearest outcome (see bc4).

title: Rescission of rights under a published deed

expect.why: [cpca 519 ¶1] says the claim is heard under the code's procedure 'مع مراعاة الأحكام الخاصة بشهر دعاوى الفسخ أو الإبطال أو التعديل أو نقض حقوق قائمة على عقود تم شهرها'. The special provisions are not in the texts given, so whether they change the ordinary rule of [cpca 17 ¶3] (and how) is not settled: the rule must warn, never decide.

title: Annulment of rights under a published deed

expect.why: [cpca 515 ¶1] gives the real-estate section jurisdiction over claims to annul, rescind, amend or set aside 'الحقوق المترتبة على عقود تم شهرها'. Together with [cpca 519 ¶1] the publication of such claims follows special provisions that the texts do not give; the text does not settle this.

title: Amendment (correction) of rights under a published deed

expect.why: [cpca 519 ¶1] names 'التعديل' among the claims with special publication provisions that are not in the texts given. I read the request kind 'correction' as the closest to 'تعديل'; that mapping is itself uncertain, so the text does not settle this.

title: Pre-emption (shufa) of a published property, deposit not stated

expect.why: [cpca 512 ¶7] lists 'الشفعة' among real-estate disputes, so [cpca 17 ¶3] applies when the property is published. Both conditions hold; the deposit for publication is not known, so the rule must ask. No slot for the request kind exists, hence 'other'.

title: Lease of a dwelling, property not published

expect.why: [cpca 512 ¶11] makes a dwelling or professional-premises lease a real-estate matter, but [cpca 17 ¶3] requires publication only for property or a real right that is 'مشهر'. The property is not published, so the step is not required. stepExempt is the nearest outcome (see bc4).

title: Lease of a dwelling, publication status unknown

expect.why: A slot left out is unknown, never 'no'. Whether the premises are published decides whether [cpca 17 ¶3] applies, so the rule must ask.

title: Partition of a published property, petition on the first day of a leap-year-free calendar edge

expect.why: [cpca 512 ¶10] lists 'القسمة وتحديد المعالم'. The limit of [cpca 17 ¶3] is the first hearing at which the case is called, not a period counted from the petition date, so the petition date (31 December) does not change the result. The deposit for publication is unknown: ask. No lastDay is given because the first-hearing date is not a slot.

title: Co-ownership (shuyu) of a published property, all facts known except the deposit

expect.why: [cpca 512 ¶5] covers 'الملكية على الشيوع'. The step is required; the deposit is the one missing fact (no slot holds it), so the rule asks. The case has no time limit the texts let me compute.

title: Claim to ownership of a published property by a public administrative body defendant

expect.why: The texts given do not say whether a claim against a public administrative body leaves the ordinary courts, nor whether [cpca 17 ¶3] applies unchanged there. The text does not settle this; the rule must warn, never decide.
